notes: ACCESS: plain requests and jina (403) and WebFetch (403) are blocked by Akamai; curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131 returned 200 on every URL, exactly as notes/74.md recorded. TREE: enumerated the complete category tree from SiteMap_CAT_001-004_v2.xml (unprotected, 131 URLs, 005+ = 404). Keyword-swept all 131 URLs for furniture/sofa/chair/table/bed/desk/cabinet/wardrobe/stool/bench/dresser/shelving/bookcase/seating/nightstand/armchair/ottoman/headboard/daybed/pouf/vanity/console/dining and the Spanish/French equivalents: exactly two hits, /bedding-home/decor/furniture/ (the real listing) and /inspiration-hub/behind-the-designs/furniture/ (an editorial story page, excluded per the never-extract rule). The whole home tree is bath/, bedding/, decor/(furniture, lighting, pillow-covers, decorative-accessories, throws), rugs/, collections/, features/, all-home/; everything else is clothing/shoes/accessories. Garnet Hill is an apparel+bedding catalog, so Furniture is one single undifferentiated node. DEPTH: the site is a IBM WebSphere PWA shell (homepage HTML carries zero nav hrefs), so the tree came from the sitemap plus the Unbxd multilevel facet. The Unbxd response for categoryId 191591 shows breadcrumb Bedding & Home > Home Decor > Furniture terminating at level 3 with no level-4 bucket, i.e. Furniture has no child categories - it is a genuine leaf, recorded as such. It does carry a 'Type' refinement facet (Beds 16, Side Tables 7, Seating 6, Dressers 3 = 32 of 35, 3 untyped); these are filter refinements with no category URL of their own and do not sum to the total, so they were NOT emitted as sub-categories per the no-filter-pages rule. COUNT: the rendered listing header could not be obtained (the grid is client-rendered and all three rendering proxies 403), so the qty comes from the storefront's own grid request - GET /UnbxdAPI?categoryId=191591&returnRespAsJSON=true&isAPI=true&requesttype=ajax with header CBI-AJAX:1 - field numberOfProducts=35. This is the exact XHR the page itself issues to build the grid, not a third-party vendor total. SANITY CHECKS: (1) the products array returned exactly 35 objects with 35 distinct uniqueId values; (2) boundary check - unbxdStart=34 returned 1 tile, unbxdStart=35 returned 0 tiles; (3) the same API's own multilevel facet independently lists 'Furniture 35'; (4) discrimination - sibling categories return different numbers (Lighting 27, Decorative Accessories 8), so it is not a site-wide constant; (5) two reads of Furniture both returned 35, no drift; (6) the page h1/title is 'Home Furniture' and categoryName in the JSON is 'Furniture', so the right listing was loaded. CONTENT CHECK: read all 35 product names - 16 beds/bedframes/daybeds, 4 nightstands, 3 dressers, 6 side/pedestal tables, 1 storage bench, 2 upholstered chairs, 3 poufs, 1 wall-mounted headboard. All in scope; no mirrors, lighting, mattresses or decor SKUs mixed in. Poufs kept because the site itself files them under Furniture (seating). EXCLUDED: bedding/, bath/, rugs/, decor/pillow-covers/, decor/throws/ (all textiles); decor/lighting/ (lighting); decor/decorative-accessories/ (decor objects); bedding-home/all-home/ (shop-all rollup); collections/, features/, linen/, 50th-anniversary/, new-arrivals/, sale-clearance/ (marketing/re-cut pages); the entire clothing/shoes/accessories tree.

rows.evidence: storefront grid XHR GET https://www.garnethill.com/UnbxdAPI?categoryId=191591&returnRespAsJSON=true&isAPI=true&requesttype=ajax (header CBI-AJAX:1) -> numberOfProducts="35"; products array returned exactly 35 objects with 35 unique uniqueId values; boundary check unbxdStart=34 -> 1 tile, unbxdStart=35 -> 0 tiles; same response's facets.multilevel bucket independently lists "Furniture",35. Rendered header unobtainable (client-rendered PWA grid, Akamai 403 on jina/WebFetch).
